title: Adjacency matrix from a word
statement: Given a natural number $n$ and a Boolean word $w$, define an $n$-by-$n$ Boolean matrix whose entry in row $i$ and column $j$ is the $(in+j)$-th entry of $w$, using false when that position is outside the word.
